audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Peter text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for false teachers, exploitation, Noah/Lot examples, arrogance, corruption, return imagery. Strong polemic held as warning against predatory teaching.

verses.restored: But false prophets also came among the people, as also false teachers will be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive sects/opinions, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing swift destruction upon themselves.

familiar.text: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

verses.restored: And many will follow their licentious ways, because of whom the way of truth will be blasphemed.

familiar.text: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

verses.restored: And in greed they will exploit you with fabricated words; their judgment from long ago is not idle, and their destruction does not sleep.

familiar.text: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

verses.restored: For if the Divine did not spare messengers who sinned/misaligned, but cast them into gloomy pits, handing them over to be kept for judgment,

familiar.text: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

verses.restored: and did not spare ancient world but guarded Noah, eighth, herald of righteousness/justice, bringing flood upon world of irreverent ones,

familiar.text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

verses.restored: and condemned cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ruin, reducing them to ashes, setting example of what is coming to irreverent ones,

familiar.text: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

verses.restored: and rescued righteous/just Lot, worn down by conduct of lawless ones in licentiousness,

familiar.text: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

verses.restored: for by seeing and hearing, the righteous/just one dwelling among them day by day was tormenting righteous/just soul/life with their lawless works,

familiar.text: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

verses.restored: then Lord knows to rescue reverent ones from testing and to keep unjust ones for day of judgment being corrected,

familiar.text: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

verses.restored: especially those going after flesh in defiling desire and despising lordship. Bold, self-willed, they do not tremble blaspheming glories,

familiar.text: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

verses.restored: whereas messengers, being greater in strength and power, do not bring against them blasphemous judgment before Lord.

familiar.text: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

verses.restored: But these, like irrational living creatures born by nature for capture and decay, blaspheming in things they do not know, will also decay in their corruption,

familiar.text: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

verses.restored: being wronged as wages of wrongdoing; considering daytime indulgence pleasure, stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceits while feasting with you,

familiar.text: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

verses.restored: having eyes full of adultery and unceasing from sin/misalignment, enticing unstable souls/lives, having a heart trained in greed, children of curse.

familiar.text: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

verses.restored: Leaving straight way, they wandered, following way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved wages of wrongdoing,

familiar.text: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

verses.restored: but had rebuke for his own lawlessness: a voiceless donkey, speaking in human voice, restrained the prophet's madness.

familiar.text: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

verses.restored: These are waterless springs and mists driven by storm, for whom gloom of darkness has been kept.

familiar.text: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

verses.restored: For speaking swollen empty things, they entice in fleshly desires and licentiousness those barely escaping from those living in error.

familiar.text: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

verses.restored: Promising them freedom while they themselves are enslaved to corruption; for by what someone is overcome, to this one is enslaved.

familiar.text: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

verses.restored: For if, having escaped defilements of the world by knowledge of Lord and Savior Jesus Messiah, and being entangled again in these, they are overcome, the last things have become worse for them than the first.

familiar.text: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

verses.restored: For it would have been better for them not to have known way of righteousness/justice than, having known, to turn back from holy command handed over to them.

familiar.text: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

verses.restored: It has happened to them according to true proverb: Dog returned to its own vomit, and washed sow to wallowing in mud.

familiar.text: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

safety_note: 2 Peter 2 is severe polemic against exploitative false teachers. Do not use animal imagery or judgment language to dehumanize vulnerable people or ordinary opponents. The target is predatory, greedy, deceptive leadership that exploits unstable souls/lives.
translation_notes: Sodom/Gomorrah is framed around lawlessness and predatory injustice in this passage; avoid later sexualized prooftext misuse.
False freedom is exposed as enslavement to corruption.
